sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and type checking switch
sections.what: Brings in the Express web type and the storage service and its error type, and turns off type checking for this file.
sections.why: Likely reason: the header comment says type checking was turned off to suppress return-type mismatches from the handler pattern.
sections.watch_out: With type checking off, mismatches in this file are hidden, so review the handlers by hand after any edit.

sections.name: registerObjectStorageRoutes
sections.title: Sets up the file upload and serving routes
sections.what: Attaches the two object storage routes to the web app and creates one storage service for them. The comments describe these as example routes to adapt for each use.
sections.why: The comment says these are examples that should be customised, including adding login checks, saving file details to a database, and access rules.
sections.watch_out: No login check, database save, or access rule is visible here, so anyone who can reach the server can request an upload link.

sections.name: post
sections.title: Gives the browser an upload link
sections.what: Handles a request to start an upload. It requires a name, then returns a temporary upload address and the short path to store for later. It echoes back the name, size and content type, but does not receive the file itself.
sections.why: The comment says the client should send only the details first, then upload the file straight to the storage address.
sections.watch_out: Size and content type are echoed back but never checked, and nothing is saved, so the file is not linked to any record in this code.

sections.name: get
sections.title: Serves stored files to the browser
sections.what: Finds a stored file from its /objects/ path and sends it to the browser. Returns 404 if the file is not found, and 500 for any other error.
sections.why: Stated in the comment: it serves uploads back to users. The comment says protected files would need an added check that is not present.
sections.watch_out: No access check is visible, so anyone who knows or guesses the path can download the file.
